label: AH
notes: IPsec Authentication Header over IPv4 transport (protocol 51). The 12-byte fixed header is modelled in full. The variable-length Integrity Check Value and padding that follow depend on the SA's authentication algorithm and are not modelled; neither is the protected payload. ESP (RFC 4303) is a separate entry and IKE is out of scope.

fields.label: Next Header
fields.description: IP protocol number of the payload: 4 IPv4, 6 TCP, 17 UDP, 50 ESP, 51 AH.

fields.label: Payload Length
fields.description: Length of the AH in 32-bit words minus 2; 2 for a bare 12-byte header.

fields.label: Reserved
fields.description: Reserved for future use; sent as zero.
